name: Noah Bennett
demo_note: Fictional persona — synthetic demo data only. Not a real person, no real records. Built to demo the DRAFT surface: a meeting just held, ready to be written up as a case note.
summary_line: 18, left sixth form after one term; days and nights flipped; wants games/IT work; opens up over shared interests.

records.author: H. Okonkwo (Tutor)
records.text: Noah left the BTEC IT course after the autumn term. Capable — strong on the practical units — but attendance collapsed after October. Said he 'wasn't sleeping right'. Polite, never any trouble; just stopped coming in.

records.author: T. Howells (Work Coach)
records.text: Wants 'something with computers' — mentioned games and IT support. Says he can't do early starts; his sleep is 'all over the place'. Agreed to look at flexible or later-start options. Marked as needing additional support.

records.author: Sam Ellison (Keyworker)
records.text: First proper conversation — clicked once we talked about the games he builds in his spare time. Clearly skilled and self-taught. The 'dropped out' framing misses it: he's been making things the whole time, just not in a classroom at 9am. Sleep is the real blocker. Plan: find a later-start IT/games pathway and tackle the sleep routine.

records.source: Northgate Futures — Meeting quick-capture (to write up)
records.author: Sam Ellison (Keyworker)
records.text: Bullets from today's session, to write up properly: showed me a game demo he made; really good. Open College has an evening Level 2 IT course (starts 4pm) — he liked the time. Worried about funding + getting there (no bus money). Agreed I'd check funding and he'd come to next Tuesday's drop-in. Mood up today.
